reuse.why: Fintegra reuses bank selection, link validation, transaction downloading and sync processing, although local unlink cleanup is copied rather than extracted.

duplication.why: The Fintegra handler repeats account creation/upgrading and initial-sync orchestration, while claimBankAccount duplicates unlinkAccount's field-reset block.

placement.why: Link policies, provider handlers, download logic, configuration and model types remain in their established modules and layers.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested linking policies, Fintegra integration and accompanying tests.

maintainability.why: Centralized linking policies simplify future changes, but another copied linking workflow and a second unlink-reset definition increase maintenance work.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Existing shared bank and sync helpers are used; unlinkAccount includes remote cleanup and cannot directly serve the required local-only takeover.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated linking workflow and unlink field resets are direct, recognizable copies rather than disguised implementations.

abstraction_drift.where: The shared downloader gains serverUrl and providerName, and the shared claim policy gains replaceExistingLink; these express required variation without provider-specific helper branches or callers bypassing the shared policies.
